lead_sources.name: Trade Me jobs
lead_sources.note: Reads only the public Auckland City category listing pages that Trade Me's robots.txt allows. Individual advert pages are permitted by robots.txt but are deliberately not fetched: they carry no workplace coordinate, so a listing could never satisfy this project's verified-location rule.

lead_sources.name: SEEK NZ
lead_sources.note: Reads only Auckland search pages. SEEK's robots.txt disallows */job/, so no advert page is ever requested and individual adverts are linked for manual checking only. Indeed NZ is not configured: its search pages return HTTP 403 to a plain client.
